title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of Vukovar
part_text: 1.Commemorates and honours all the victims of Vukovar and all those who suffered atrocities during Milošević’s Greater Serbian aggression against Croatia; pays solemn tribute to those who defended Croatia, to the wounded and displaced, to the families of the fallen andthe missing, and to civilian victims of war, regardless of their background; notes the enduring place of their courage, sacrifice and suffering in Croatia’s national memory; reaffirms Europe’s shared responsibility to preserve peace, uphold human dignity and defend freedom; stresses that all civilian victims, regardless of their nationality or ethnicity, deserve recognition, dignity and remembrance;
